plugins._comment: DO NOT set NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription back to false. App Store Connect validation (error 90683) requires it because the react-native-healthkit binary REFERENCES HealthKit write APIs — Apple's validator scans for API references, not calls. We never write; the string states exactly that. Removing it breaks App Store upload. Read-only plist posture (D-046) is not achievable while this library is in the bundle.
plugins.NSHealthShareUsageDescription: Klippa reads your steps, walking distance, and active energy to add them to your mow log.
plugins.NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: Klippa does not write to Apple Health. This permission is required by a library the app includes but is never used.

plugins.photosPermission: Klippa adds photos of your lawn to a mow's before/after record.
plugins.cameraPermission: Klippa lets you photograph your lawn before and after a mow.

infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Klippa uses your location to center the map on your yard so you can trace its boundary.
